{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude those with sentinel age (-1)
valid_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_age_converted)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}")"}
